author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices question and answer, steady beat, finding C, echoing short patterns, counting to three and taking turns, with an old London street song.

classes.title: Do you know? Yes, I know!
classes.goal: Hear the song as a question and answer it together.

mathTarget.parentLine: One voice asks, the other answers, then we swap

classes.parentPrompt: Sing 'do you know the muffin man?' with a curious face; nod big when your child answers.
classes.childAction: Sway, listen to the question, then shout 'Yes, I know!'
classes.bridge: The song knocks on a door with a question; you open it with an answer.

intro.caption: Listen, the song asks a question
intro.parentCue: sway together and make a curious face

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: asking and answering, taking turns.

classes.title: Knock-knock beat
classes.goal: Tap one steady tap for every beat, like knocking on the muffin man's door.

mathTarget.parentLine: One knock for each beat, no more, no less

classes.parentPrompt: Rest your hand over your child's hand and knock-tap together, then slowly let go.
classes.childAction: Tap any key once for each beat, knock, knock, knock.
classes.bridge: Each beat is one knock on the muffin man's door.

intro.caption: Knock, knock, on every beat
intro.parentCue: knock gently on your child's back with the beat

games.caption: Knock along: do you know?
games.parentCue: Knock softly together on each beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: one tap for each beat.

classes.title: Find C, the muffin door
classes.goal: Find the special note C by using the two black keys as a landmark.

mathTarget.parentLine: Finding a place by what sits next to it

classes.parentPrompt: Guide your child's finger to two black keys, then slide just left to C.
classes.childAction: Touch the two black keys, slide left, and press C gently.
classes.bridge: C is the front door, just left of the two black keys.

intro.caption: Where does C live?
intro.parentCue: touch the two black keys together first

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding C next to the two black keys.

classes.title: Echo up the steps
classes.goal: Hold two or three notes in mind, then copy them back on the keys.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping a short line of sounds in mind, in order

classes.parentPrompt: Play the short call, then fold your hands and wait for your child's answer.
classes.childAction: Listen to the call, then play it back the same way.
classes.bridge: C, D, E are three steps up to the muffin man's door.

intro.caption: I call, you answer
intro.parentCue: sing the notes, let your child copy

games.caption: Three steps up: C, D, E
games.parentCue: Count the steps: one, two, three

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: listening and copying short patterns.

classes.title: Same shape, one step down
classes.goal: Echo 'the muffin man' twice and hear the same shape move lower.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same little pattern, moved lower on the piano

classes.parentPrompt: Draw a little hill in the air for each 'muffin man', the second one lower.
classes.childAction: Play the little hill, then play it again lower down.
classes.bridge: The muffin man walks down the lane: same steps, one house to the left.

intro.caption: The muffin man, the muffin man
intro.parentCue: draw a little hill in the air, twice

games.caption: The muffin man: B, D, D, B
games.parentCue: Draw the hill as your child plays

games.caption: Lower now: G, B, B, G

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: the same pattern in a new place.

classes.title: Long C: one, two, three
classes.goal: Wait for C in the song and hold the last long C for three counts.

mathTarget.parentLine: The last C lasts three counts: one, two, three

classes.parentPrompt: Play your notes; when the last C comes, count 'one, two, three' with your fingers.
classes.childAction: Wait for your turn, play C, and hold it: one, two, three!
classes.bridge: The last C is a long stay at the door: one, two, three.

intro.caption: Wait, wait, now it's C!
intro.parentCue: hands in lap until the C comes

games.caption: Drury Lane: hold C for three
games.parentCue: Count three fingers on the long C

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: waiting your turn and counting three.

classes.title: Muffin man duet
classes.goal: Play the whole song together at full speed, sharing one beat.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two different jobs fit together to make one song

classes.parentPrompt: Play your blue keys and smile; if your child misses a C, keep going.
classes.childAction: Play your C notes while your grown-up plays the rest.
classes.bridge: You are the muffin man with C; I bring all the other notes.

intro.caption: You play C, I play the rest
intro.parentCue: sit side by side at the piano

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing one song together, two jobs.

classes.title: Who knows the muffin man?
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy and spot when the question comes back.

mathTarget.parentLine: The 'do you know' line comes back; we can spot it

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; raise your hand each time 'Oh, do you know' comes back.
classes.childAction: Play to the end; raise a hand when the question returns.
classes.bridge: The question knocks twice; the last line answers: on Drury Lane.

intro.caption: A song for teddy!
intro.parentCue: put teddy in front as the audience

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: a whole song and spotting what repeats.
